recoveryRules.STEP_FAILURE: Compensate all preceding reversible steps in exact reverse topological order (N-1 -> 1).
recoveryRules.TIMEOUT: Verify authoritative world state invariants before retrying or compensating.
recoveryRules.DUPLICATE_REQUEST: Lookup durable idempotency key in log. If COMPLETED, return cached response with zero duplicate side effects.
recoveryRules.UNKNOWN_STATE: Query authoritative mocked state store before proceeding.
recoveryRules.COMPENSATION_FAILURE: Attempt safe retry. If remote lock conflict persists, halt and raise HUMAN INTERVENTION REQUIRED.
recoveryRules.IRREVERSIBLE_ACTION: Intercept execution before irreversible step (email/SMS), enforce human authorization dialog.
recoveryRules.CRASH: Read durable persistent log, recover completed checkpoints, resume from step K+1 without re-executing steps 1..K.
